Coverage_Description: Campus Student Dental Clinic services under the Student Dental Benefit Scheme for full-time students; appointment-based dental care during consultation hours, with emergency routing after hours
pricing: HK$30 penalty per 15-minute dentist appointment or per 30-minute hygienist appointment if cancelled with less than 24 hours' notice.
customer requirement: Eligible PolyU full-time students; one-month service grace period after graduation eligibility confirmation
price structure: Per-visit charge schedule (in scheme leaflet) plus fixed HK$30 late-cancellation/no-show penalty by appointment block
additional informations: booking via phone, online, or in person; clinic at Room GH020, Core H
